raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "it"
  role object "none of the flights from Dublin to Bucharest are direct"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "fly"
  role subject "the user"
  role source "Dublin"
  role destination "Bucharest"
  role instrument "a direct flight"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  mode exists
  where match
    relation "be direct"
    role subject ?f
    role object "a flight from Dublin to Bucharest"
    polarity affirmed
  end
